title: Modern Treasury footer
description: A deep forest-green footer: a newsletter row (bold line, muted line, a white email field and a pale mint button), a hairline, six columns of small muted links under white headings (two columns on phones), and a legal row with the copyright, one link and grey social icons.
notes: always dark: it carries the dark class, so it uses the theme's dark colours in both modes
social icons come in as nodes (any icon set)
